interpretation_limits: Current125training memory contains no exact cross-slot coverage training; adjacent query/log-prior mixtures do not establish this mechanism.
Mean and LOO each aggregate probabilities before tanh; not mean(logP), not a fixed linear query remix.
Positive means re-emphasize covered positions, negative means reduce relative attention; covered does not imply irrelevant.
Mean/LOO do not isolate cross-slot benefit versus a same-transform own-slot control, which is not included in this8-run budget.
q4/q8 are distinct parents; LOO-minus-mean strength differs with1/(S-1). No pooled architecture causal claim.
Query slots are not the4task labels. Task-dependent prior cycle benefit does not predict new coverage gains or an only-buy rule.
Parameter/layout identity does not imply equal initial function in active modes, equal gradients, optimizer trajectories, FLOPs, or fused kernels.
AUC/BCE gains measure prediction; attention novelty/coverage/entropy is not information-theoretic gain or a quality surrogate.
Same-format zero-bias fixture quantifies local numerical format effects, not trained equivalence; significant failures require design review and substantive controls.

Parent comparisons test coverage plus its required execution path. Same-format local agreement cannot isolate a trained coverage-only effect; an explicit format-zero training control would be required for that stronger attribution, not silently added to this budget.
